author: Madmoney
text:
althoufx wrote: Hi MM brilliant spots, nice trades! would you please share what you mean for "mouth of FL"?

many thanks, all the best Hi althoufx, I'll try my best to put it into words(please IF and any experts please correct me).

To me every big FL has a mouth, which is usually the last barrier of defence between the MPL and the outside of the FL (kinda like PAZ), if the mouth gets engulfed the price free to travel to the MPL of the FL.

Now a FL mouth can break and still reverse in the opposite direction, this is usually because an opposing FL mouth has been engulfed first.

Here is a picture If you guys need more explaining or more questions, I'll try my best.

MM thanks a lot for yout explaination. Now i'll try to summarize what comes out from this new stuff, at least i'll try to check what i've understood 1. at the point the price leaves from a FL just created (boundary), it makes a barrier, meaning a pocket of orders. Perhaps a FL in Lower TF?

It is the FL's mouth 2. since the FL's mouth got broken, the price will go through up to the FL's MPL. It is not by chance, because if the price has priorities in doing that (chronological, so first it respects the earliest breaks) it means itwillgo through. So the FL behaves as a PAZ.

The only question could be - when, after a break, the price will complete going through to MPL?

the answer: - after the previous mouth breaks had been closed, so after the price had reached earlier respective MPLs am i wrong?

many thanks, all the best!
